title: `toc_tokens` name for `# Foo > & bar` is not HTML-escaped
spec:
This is the Python-Markdown library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q`.

I build my own navigation from `md.toc_tokens` and insert each `name` into HTML. Headers containing `<`, `>` or `&` come through unescaped, so the token name disagrees with `md.toc` and is unsafe to insert.

```
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['markdown.extensions.toc'])
md.convert('# Foo > & bar')
md.toc_tokens
```

Expected:
```
[{'level': 1, 'id': 'foo-bar', 'name': 'Foo > & bar', 'children': []}]
```

Actual:
```
[{'level': 1, 'id': 'foo-bar', 'name': 'Foo > & bar', 'children': []}]
```

Similar inputs are probably affected too; please fix the underlying problem rather than just this case.
acceptance: the reported example produces the expected output
the underlying problem is fixed, not just the reported input
